The share is a fraction (count divided by the total, between 0 and 1). The difference is share minus average share, as a fraction.
The share is a percentage (count divided by the total, times 100). The difference is share minus average share, in percentage points.

The comparison is strict: only shares greater than the average are kept, so observatories exactly at the average are excluded.
Ties at the 10th place are broken arbitrarily, and exactly 10 rows are returned. If fewer than 10 observatories qualify, all qualifying rows are returned.
The total number of telescopes is the count of all rows in telescopes, including any whose `observstation` has no match in the observatories table.
The total number of telescopes counts only telescopes whose `observstation` matches an observatory in the observatories table (inner join).

Telescope count is the number of distinct `telescregistry` values per observatory. Since it is the primary key, this equals the row count.

queries: SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation);
SELECT 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_share FROM observatories

SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
FROM observatories o
LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.observstation
HAVING COUNT(t.telescregistry) > (
  SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(t2.telescregistry) AS cnt
    FROM observatories o2
    LEFT JOIN telescopes t2 ON t2.observstation = o2.observstation
    GROUP BY o2.observstation
  )
)
